_comment: Vertical slice cast (brief section 69): Rowan, Maeve, a knight-type ally,
an archer-type ally, goblin rank and file, and the goblin commander boss.
IMPORTANT: these entries use text-to-3d, which makes them BLOCKOUTS, not
final heroes. Brief section 55 requires named characters to go through
approved front/side/back concept art. Once the director signs off on
concepts, add their URLs to the 'references' array on that entry and
regenerate: the pipeline switches to image-to-3d automatically and the mesh
follows the approved design instead of the prompt's interpretation.
Animation names resolve through Tools/hollowasset/animations.py. The action
ids there are still provisional, so the first character generated should
bake all fourteen clips for review before the rest of the cast is run.
